basic.name: Sand Blast
basic.description:
After 0.5 seconds, fire a missile that deals 305~~0.04~~ damage to the first enemy hit. Deals 50% damage to Structures.

Casting Sand Blast leaves an Echo behind that mimics Chromie's Sand Blast and Basic Attack, dealing 40% damage. Maximum of 1 Echo active at a time.

basic.name: Dragon’s Breath
basic.description:
Vector Targeting
Launch 3 blasts into the air that land every 0.75 seconds towards the targeted direction, dealing 215~~0.04~~ damage each.

basic.name: Time Trap
basic.description: Place a Time Trap that arms and Stealths after 2 seconds. Chromie's Trait can be activated to detonate the trap, placing all nearby allied or enemy Heroes in Time Stop for 2 seconds. Maximum of 1 trap active at a time.

heroic.name: Temporal Loop
heroic.description:
Choose an enemy Hero. After 3 seconds, they are teleported back to the location where Temporal Loop was cast on them.

Basic Abilities recharge 500% faster for 3 seconds after casting Temporal Loop.

heroic.name: Slowing Sands
heroic.description: Summon a sand vortex that Slows enemies by 10% every 0.25 seconds, up to 70%.

trait.name: Timewalker
trait.description:
Chromie has traveled to the future, and as such, will learn her Talents 2 levels earlier than her teammates!

Detonate Time Trap

Detonates active Time Traps.

trait.name: Detonate Time Trap
trait.description: Detonates active Time Traps, placing all nearby allied or enemy Heroes in Time Stop for 2 seconds.

activable.name: Timewalker's Pursuit
activable.description: Activate to reveal the targeted area for 4 seconds. Enemies seen are revealed for 4 seconds.

activable.name: Here and There
activable.description: Activate to teleport to an area near an Echo, swapping it with Chromie's previous location.

activable.name: Time Out
activable.description: Activate to place Chromie in Stasis and gain Invulnerability for up to 5 seconds. Can be reactivated to end the effect early.

activable.name: Quantum Overdrive
activable.description: Activate to increase Spell Power by 30% for 8 seconds. Hitting an enemy Hero with Sand Blast reduces this cooldown by 3 seconds.

activable.name: Blessing of the Bronze
activable.description:
Activate to cause Chromie and all allied Heroes to gain 20% Movement Speed and their Basic Abilities recharge 35% faster for 8 seconds.

Hitting an enemy Hero with Sand Blast from Chromie or her Echoes reduces the cooldown of Blessing of the Bronze by 1 second.

level1.name: Once Again the First Time
level1.description:
Quest: Hit 20 Heroes with Sand Blast from Chromie or her Echoes without dying.

Reward: Increase the maximum number of active Echoes to 2, and increase Echo damage to 50%.

level1.name: Deep Breathing
level1.description:
Quest: Every time Dragon's Breath hits a Hero increase its damage by 0.5%.

Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, reduce the cooldown of Dragon's Breath by 4 seconds and its Mana cost from 65 to 40.

level1.name: Timewalker's Pursuit
level1.description: Gain 15% Spell Power and reduce the arming time of Time Traps by 0.75 seconds. Activate to reveal the targeted area for 4 seconds. Enemies seen are revealed for 4 seconds.

level4.name: Chronic Conditions
level4.description:
Time Trap will activate on enemy Heroes automatically.

After its Time Stop ends, enemies affected by Time Trap are Slowed by 25% for 3 seconds and allies gain 25% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

level4.name: Time Troubles
level4.description: After its Time Stop ends, enemies affected by Time Trap lose 15 Armor for 3 seconds and allies gain 30 Armor for 3 seconds.

level4.name: Andorhal Anomaly
level4.description: Increase the charges and maximum active Time Traps to 3, and reduce its cooldown by 8 seconds.

level7.name: Bronze Talons
level7.description: Hitting a Hero with Sand Blast from Chromie or her Echoes grants 50% additional Basic Attack damage for 5 seconds.

level7.name: Mobius Loop
level7.description: Dragon's Breath deals 30% bonus damage to enemies hit by its center. Enemy Heroes hit by its center are Slowed by 40% for 0.75 seconds.

level7.name: A Proper Greeting
level7.description: Damaging a Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed enemy Hero grants 20% additional damage for 3 seconds.

level10.name: Slowing Sands
level10.description: Summon a sand vortex that Slows enemies by 10% every 0.25 seconds, up to 70%.

level10.name: Temporal Loop
level10.description:
Choose an enemy Hero. After 3 seconds, they are teleported back to the location where Temporal Loop was cast on them.

Basic Abilities recharge 500% faster for 3 seconds after casting Temporal Loop.

level13.name: Gnome Speed Ahead!
level13.description: After casting Sand Blast, Chromie gains 20% Movement Speed and 200% increased Health Regeneration for 3 seconds.

level13.name: Here and There
level13.description: Activate to teleport to an area near an Echo, swapping it with Chromie's previous location.

level13.name: Time Out
level13.description: Activate to place Chromie in Stasis and gain Invulnerability for up to 5 seconds. Can be reactivated to end the effect early.

level16.name: Shifting Sands
level16.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Chromie's primary Sand Blast grants 5% Spell Power for 8 seconds, up to a maximum of 50%. The duration is refreshed whenever an enemy is damaged by the primary Sand Blast.

level16.name: Fast Forward
level16.description: If Chromie's primary Sand Blast travels at least 50% of its base distance and hits a Hero, its cooldown is reduced to 0.5 seconds and it refunds 10 Mana.

level16.name: Quantum Overdrive
level16.description: Activate to increase Spell Power by 30% for 8 seconds. Hitting an enemy Hero with Sand Blast reduces this cooldown by 3 seconds.

level20.name: Unravelling
level20.description:
Every 0.25 seconds, enemy Heroes Slowed by Slowing Sands have their Spell Armor reduced by 10 up to 50.

Passive: Increase Slowing Sands cast range by 50%, and Slowing Sands persists for 5 seconds after it is cancelled.

level20.name: Stuck in a Loop
level20.description: Temporal Loop teleports the target a second time after the first, and Basic Abilities continue recharging for an additional 3 seconds. Increase the cooldown recharge rate from 500% to 700%.

level20.name: Piercing Sands
level20.description: Sand Blasts cast from Chromie and her Echoes now pierce all enemies hit.

level20.name: Blessing of the Bronze
level20.description:
Activate to cause Chromie and all allied Heroes to gain 20% Movement Speed and their Basic Abilities recharge 35% faster for 8 seconds.

Hitting an enemy Hero with Sand Blast from Chromie or her Echoes reduces the cooldown of Blessing of the Bronze by 1 second.
